gen-gf-oxanium-gf-maven-pro: Distinctive from the first line, Oxanium stands its lowercase tall and draws every stroke as one unbroken line. But Maven Pro takes over the quieter work, with a welcoming gap in the c and a gentle, modern touch.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-mochiy-pop-one: Sharp and tall, Oxanium draws monoline strokes with curves that end in clear daylight. Mochiy Pop One counters with a very large lowercase eye and letters hung like clothespins along a long line.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Sharp and tidy, Oxanium traces every glyph with one thickness. Noto Sans Adlam follows with well-separated curve endings and tall, full c, s and z, so both sit together in crisp, open lines.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Noto Sans Arabic opens its small letters wide, with a pronounced x-height. The ring of each o in Oxanium keeps a constant wall, so the two work together as bold shapes above open text.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-bengali: Noto Sans Bengali keeps capitals barely taller than lowercase, while Oxanium holds rod-stock lines of identical thickness. Noto Sans Bengali then carries running text with a smooth, steady rhythm, its open mouths never clogging.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-bhaiksuki: Oxanium draws even its g in one unchanging line weight, and its curves end in clear, generous daylight. Noto Sans Bhaiksuki adds the warmth: swollen, rope-coiled lowercase with open apertures.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-buhid: Oxanium glows like neon tubing, one thickness from start to finish. Noto Sans Buhid then glides down the page in a modern, unhurried way, curve ends held a generous distance from the stems.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-carian: Oxanium is monoline from start to finish, tall in the lowercase. Noto Sans Carian reads cleanly line after line, its terminals staying apart like open scissor blades, with tiny gaps under the ascender tops.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-chakma: Distinctive and commanding, Oxanium keeps its joins as sturdy as its stems. Noto Sans Chakma is approachable over long runs, its lowercase packed up toward the caps and its s and c left open and uncrowded.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-cherokee: Noto Sans Cherokee reads in an approachable, tall band, its e leaving a wide gap at the terminal. And across a full page of it, the text stays smooth, while Oxanium above shows no thick-thin flicker.
